answer: At dawn each agent must prove it is listed on a civic registry — one verified voter-roll entry per identity, checked against a signed relic of the roll snapshot. A farm cloning 1,000 agents needs 1,000 separate fraudulent enrolments, each costing about $40 and weeks of processing, while the registry audit flags duplicate addresses. When the delta between enrolment date and first activity is under 48 hours for a cluster, the whole cluster is frozen and its 500-POA bond slashed. A 300-agent ring was caught when 300 enrolments shared one postal address.
